But that doesn’t stop the varsity captain, Max, from falling for her. Together, Max and Becca hide her secret from scheming soccer players, a vengeful ex, and the soccer coach from Hell. But with a baby on the way, will Max give up his picture perfect image to be with Becca?

book_title: Falling for My Dad's Best Friend
special_desc: In Falling for My Dad's Best Friend, Kylie, a bold young woman infatuated with her dad's best friend. Jaxon tests his limits as she tempts him with Kylie's charm. As Jaxon struggles to resist her, the tension between them escalates, leading to an ultimate betrayal that changes everything.

book_title: Big Bad Husband, Please Wake Up! 2
special_desc: Ellie Holland is forced to marry bigshot billionaire Wayne Lyons in order to save her father's life. For the hefty price of five million dollars, Ellie sold herself into the Lyons family with the promise of delivering an heir. There's just one catch… Wayne Lyons is in a coma!

book_title: Hey Boss, Your Company is Getting Bombed
special_desc: In Hey Boss Your Company is Getting Bombed movie, Clyde is a middle-aged salesman who has been marginalized in his job. One day, he wakes up with a superpower of seeing when and how people would die. He tries to save multiple people from death, but no one believes him. A few days later, his power tells him there is going to be an explosion at his company that will kill everyone in the building. To save everyone, he has to find out who planted the bomb and stop them.

book_title: The Break-up Bet With My Billionaire Ex
special_desc: In The Break-up Bet With My Billionaire Ex movie, when Layla and Joshua break up, they sign a separation agreement: If they're both still single in five years, they get married. Five years later, after becoming the world's hottest and wealthiest chef, Joshua takes the position of head chef at the restuarant where Layla works. Joshua wants her to fulfill the contract, but with her health in an unstable condition, Layla lies and says she's already engaged. Still, an undeniable chemistry builds between them, and the flames of love become hard to suppress. Will Joshua ultimately discover Layla's lie? Can they bridge the gap of lost time and truly be together again, love conquering all?

In Crossing The Line To Love movie: three days before her wedding, freelance writer Nichole catches her fiancé in bed with her bridesmaid. In a moment of heartbreak and rage, she storms into a bar and kisses a random stranger—only to realize he’s Fabian Winston, a wildly popular contemporary artist and the sole heir to a powerful elite family. The kiss goes viral overnight. Faced with mounting public pressure and relentless media, Nichole is pushed into a contract marriage with Fabian. What starts as a scandal-driven deal slowly unravels into a messy, irresistible entanglement of power, secrets, and unexpected feelings.

When Olivia signs up for a life-saving surgery that will erase every memory - including the man who broke her heart - she's finally ready to walk away from her painful marriage. But with 14 days left on the clock, her cold, distant husband realizes too late what he's about to lose.

After realizing she's been hating the wrong man her entire life, Elena dies in the arms of her husband Marcus. In a twist of fate, Elena is brought back in time. It's not too late, she still has time to change everything. In this life, she won't hate her husband... she will protect him at all cost.

book_title: Bound by Marriage - Freed by Love
special_desc: What began as a marriage of convenience soon became a maze of lies and hidden faces. Diana thought her cold husband was the enemy — until the real nightmare revealed itself. Now, trapped in a house of secrets, the only heart she might come to trust… belongs to the man she was never meant to love.
In Song of My Mother's Tears movie, Faith searches for her lost family when she learns that she doesn't have long to live. But turns out, they're the people she hates the most!

book_title: My Firefighter Fiancé Returns as a Billionaire
special_desc: In My Firefighter Fiancé Returns as a Billionaire movie, Archer is nowhere to be seen on his wedding with Alice—rumor has it he died in an explosion during a firefighting mission. Alice’s greedy parents try to marry her off to a sleazy suitor, Philip. At the new wedding, Alice finally sees her husband again—but he’s now engaged to someone else.

In Alpha Mate Unchained movie, he killed his vicious father to save her.  Now the new Alpha King must hide his fated mate and use a decoy fake Luna to keep her alive. But while he’s away battling, she’s discovered by the Fake Luna and brutally tortured.  Can she survive long enough for the Alpha King’s return and vengeance?

book_title: I Swapped Bodies with My Nemesis
special_desc: In I Swapped Bodies with My Nemesis movie, Nick and Lexey were being forced into an arranged marriage by their parents. They despised themselves and so were against the marriage. Cupid, having heard their cries, decided to intervene. He switched their souls into each other's body. Now Nick is Lexey and Lexey is Nick. Forced to experience life from a new perspective, they must live together.

Catherine Rogers might only be the contract wife, so we can't compare her with the rightful partner! My Billionaire Sugar Baby Trailer shows this part as she has a steamy intercourse with her sugar baby, Adam Hartford. Adam teaches Catherine golf, the arts of kissing, and staying away from predators! What are his methods?

In The Elite Heir's Ultimate Comeback movie, Hector and Alice have been in love for years. But just as Hector is about to reveal his true identity, a tragic accident leaves him in a coma. Alice’s family, despite their limited resources, contributes what they can to his recovery. As Hector slowly regains consciousness, he can only communicate by pressing a call button. Meanwhile, an antagonist posing as a doctor manipulates the family. In a critical moment, Hector finally speaks, warning the antagonist that with a single phone call, he can bring them to justice.

book_title: How to Land a Movie Star
special_desc: When ambitious casting assistant Cleo Marlowe risks everything to convince movie star Blake Wilder to act in her movie, she doesn’t expect him to say yes, or for the paparazzi to catch her walking out of his house. Branded as the girl who slept her way to a get ahead, Cleo becomes Hollywood’s favorite rumor. But while her reputation takes a nosedive, the notoriously cold and gruff Blake starts to show up for her in ways she never saw coming.

Driven by an instinctive pull, Xavier, the Alpha of a rogue wolf pack, senses the emergence of his fated mate. Tracing this profound connection, he finds Dr. Isla, an Omega. Captivated by her unique blend of gentleness and resilience, Xavier is determined to claim her. However, Isla believes her destined partner is another. This sparks intense rivalry as Xavier relentlessly pursues her. Initially wary and misunderstanding Xavier's motives, Isla gradually comes to understand the complex male beneath the Alpha exterior. Their journey unfolds into a thrilling and passionate romance. Yet, their burgeoning bond faces relentless trials: treacherous internal pack politics and looming external threats. Ultimately, through shared peril and unwavering resolve, they overcome every obstacle, their love culminating in a lasting union.

When her boyfriend suddenly drops out of their roadtrip to her best friend's wedding, Samantha Smiles is forced to take the long drive from LA to NYC with the boy she's spent the last five years trying to forget. The boy she spent one secret summer night with. The boy she let take ALL her firsts: Tristan Montgomery, AKA her best friend's older brother! Torn between loyalty and her resurfacing (mutual?) feelings for Tristan, Samantha has to make a choice: will she keep living for others, or will she finally, for once, do something for herself?!

book_title: The Scent of My Fated Luna
special_desc: A half-witch, half-werewolf teen forced to hide her true identity struggles to survive a high school divided by magic and fangs—while resisting her fated mate, the future Alpha who doesn’t remember their childhood bond, and battling the jealous rival willing to destroy her to claim him.

After 15 years, sparks fly when Isabel and Ari reunite and become passionate lovers. She's a police detective trying to make her career by catching a mysterious master thief. As Ari helps her investigation and their affair gets steamier, will she realize that her lover is the criminal she's hunting?

In Feast of Power movie, Nick, who's secretly the wealthiest man in the world, lives as stay-at-home husband with his wife, Bella. Just as he’s about to reveal his true identity and share his wealth and power with her, he discovers Bella’s betrayal. Nick realizes he had mistaken Bella for his true love. He later finds Elena, a woman who loves him for who he is, not for his wealth or power. Determined, Nick takes back everything he had planned to give Bella and chooses to share it with Elena instead, leaving Bella full of regret.

book_title: My Sunset Love Affair with the Billionaire CEO
special_desc: Middle-aged and jobless, Jennifer loses both her pension and home to her greedy son and daughter-in-law. In a desperate attempt to turn things around, she joins a dating reality show, The Diamond Bachelor—only to meet the mysterious and charming Paul Marshall. Unbeknownst to her, Paul is a CEO hiding his true identity. Moved by Jennifer’s kindness and independence, he proposes, and they marry in a whirlwind romance. But to protect Jennifer, who despises lies and deceit, Paul and his stepdaughter Emma keep their wealthy background a secret. Together, they fiercely shield Jennifer from those who wish her harm—including her own son. Through family conflicts and emotional twists, Jennifer eventually uncovers Paul’s real identity... and the shocking truth: Emma is her long-lost daughter. A dramatic journey leads to heartfelt reunion and healing.

book_title: He Said the Baby Was Too Expensive
special_desc: In He Said the Baby Was Too Expensive movie, heiress Iris gave up her family fortune to marry Dorian, a poor average-joe. Three years later, she's about to welcome her first child, when suddenly, her crazy control-freak mother-in-law (Tessa) insists the hospital she's staying at is too expensive. Tessa manages to convince Dorian that they should switch to a cheaper hospital. Dorian, being a spineless mama's boy, gives in to all of Tessa's demands and starts bullying Iris too. Iris fights off increasingly unreasonable demands, all while dealing with unbearable pain in her heavily pregnant belly. Just as she can't take it anymore, Iris's father finally appears, bearing gifts for his new grandchild. How will Alec defend his daughter? When will Iris give her husband and mother-in-law a slap in the face?

Mia needs her wedding planning business to succeed to pay for her sister’s medical treatment. But when she falls for the groom–presidential candidate Eli Thorne–she’ll have to juggle bouquets and emotions to keep her heart and career from falling apart.

Hallie Bildner, a successful NYC CEO engaged to a billionaire politician, is shocked to learn that her high school sweetheart never signed their divorce papers. Determined to settle the past, she returns to her hometown, only to find her ex hiding two big secrets: the true reason he broke her heart and that his 7-year-old daughter is actually hers. As old feelings reignite, Hallie faces a choice between the life she built and the one she left behind.

In The Ultimate Fight for Love movie, after her parents' mysterious deaths, Harper finds herself deep in debt to shady businessman Travis Noble, who forces her to spy on enigmatic billionaire Andrew Barrett to pay him back. When Harper discovers Andrew's secret — he's an underground MMA fighter — Andrew convinces her to join him to take down Travis. But neither Harper nor Andrew ever expected the heat building between them... or how much they'd be willing to fight for it.

book_title: Never Too Late to Love You
special_desc: Ariel, a medical aesthetics sales rep, reunites with her college crush Evan during a clinic visit. As work forces them together, old feelings resurface, but romantic rivals and past misunderstandings stand in their way. When Ariel becomes the face of her company’s products, she rises to fame—until Evan’s fiancée, Sienna, frames her, turning public admiration into scandal. Can Ariel reclaim her love and reputation?

Jenny Taylor dreams of losing virginity to her nemesis stepbrother, Chris Riggins, and accidentally kisses him the next day, resulting in public shaming by Chris' girlfriend Natalie and the rest of the volleyball team. However, Chris suddenly becomes caring and considerate, defending Jenny every step of the way. Could this actually be the start of a taboo relationship?

In The Lost Daughter's Silent Cry movie, in a cruel twist of fate, Annabella Walton's perfect life is shattered. Ten years later, to save her disabled adoptive father, Annabella, now named Amelia, is forced to deal with the Walton family again...this time, as the target of their attacks. Will the Waltons figure out the truth? Or will it be too late for Amelia?

book_title: Double Life of My Military Man
special_desc: When a small-town doctor unexpectedly crosses paths with a sexy, mysterious soldier, sparks fly. But as their relationship blooms, both are forced to keep the real reasons for their whirlwind romance and the truth behind their identities a secret. He's a special forces ace and secret billionaire. She's a special ops agent undercover. Both operatives have a single mission--to investigate and ultimately eliminate one another.  Will they risk sacrificing everything for loyalty or love?

book_title: Return to Reckon with His Hateful Village
special_desc: Drama also known as Nobody Wants Him; In a small village divided by strict rules, a young man from the lower village fell in love with his childhood friend from the upper village. Unfortunately, their romance was discovered, leading to a community-wide meeting to judge him.

After losing her family and her pack, pre-med student, Yara, wants to leave the wolf world behind and live as a normal college girl. But when she stumbles across Alpha Warren, a strong, sexy pack leader and saves his life, he’s hellbent on proving to her she belongs at his side. Convinced they’re fated mates, Warren takes Yara back to his pack to make her queen. When he crowns her pack doctor, Yara goes from shy student to leading Luna, and slowly falls for the Alpha who loves her as she is.

In The Christmas Switch movie, sixteen years ago, Molly has an affair with Colton, the son-in-law of the powerful Grant family. When she gets pregnant, Colton heartlessly tells her to get an abortion. Furious and heartbroken, Molly secretly swaps her newborn daughter with the baby girl born to the Grant family’s heiress, Rachel.
That baby—Rachel’s real daughter—grows up as Dolores, raised in the slums. Meanwhile, Molly’s biological daughter, Sara, is brought up as the Grant family’s beloved princess.
Now, both girls attend the same prestigious school. Their paths cross again. Dolores, strong and kind, catches the attention of Aaron—Rachel’s father and the Grant family patriarch. At the same time, Sara’s longtime crush, Ryan, starts falling for Dolores. Feeling threatened, Sara begins scheming against her, afraid of being replaced. As tension builds, the secret behind their true identities slowly starts to unravel...

book_title: Tricked into Having my Ex-Husband's Baby
special_desc: Erica Lemon hires an escort to get her pregnant after finding out she'll soon be infertile. When her ex-husband, Damon finds out, he replaces the escort and tricks Erica into sleeping with him instead. Now pregnant with her ex-husband’s baby, Erica must decide if it’s worth giving Damon another chance to love her.

book_title: Heiress Returns: Boss's Defense and Love
special_desc: In Heiress Returns: Boss's Defense and Love movie: The daughter of the world's wealthiest man pursued a man who manipulated and mistreated women for three years, during which she endured emotional abuse. Despite transferring hundreds of millions in assets to this manipulative individual, she received no formal recognition or respect in their relationship. On their third wedding anniversary, this deceitful man brazenly introduced his mistress to her, mocking her lack of wealth, beauty, connections, and desirability, claiming she deserved to be betrayed. Unbeknownst to him, with just a single decision from her, he and his mistress would lose everything. At this critical moment, the male protagonist—a peer of the female lead in terms of wealth and family background—appears. However, due to misunderstandings orchestrated by the antagonistic secondary characters, he is mistaken for a hired model intended to embellish the scene. Ironically, both the male and female leads initially perceive each other as impostors, with the male lead even mistakenly believing the female lead is his arranged marriage partner. Enraged by the betrayal of the secondary male character, the female lead hastily signs a divorce agreement and marries the male lead. Yet, the secondary characters remain oblivious to the gravity of their actions. Let us observe how they are subsequently humiliated in various ways.

When Amelia Monroe finds out that hoemcoming queens are dying at her family's academy, she poses as a student to investigate the cause. But she meets her match with Kristy Troy - the baddest bully at Monroe Academy. When they face off for homecoming queen - who will win? And will Amelia save her family's school?

book_title: Boss, Your Wife's a Whole Detective!
special_desc: After a flash marriage arranged by her late mother’s best friend, Jenny waits three years for her husband Charles, who left abroad right after the wedding. When he returns, misunderstandings, accusations, and missed chances drive them toward divorce. Just as Jenny is framed by rivals, Charles steps in to protect her, but new twists and family schemes continue to keep them apart.

In Her Secret Crusader movie, Lyndon was the City's hero. After freeing the City from danger, he hid his identity to protect his girlfriend, Tatiana, from harm. Now City Hall is once again in danger as the Sewer rat returns to take it down. The mayor and his daughter are the Sewer rat’s target victims. With Tatiana’s betrayal revealed, Lyndon becomes a hero again.

Emma and Liam shared a magical night together that ended abruptly when Liam left the next morning without a explanation. Six months later, they get reunited at Emma's sister's wedding where Liam is the best man. As their unsolved feelings come rushing back, Emma decides to fake date Liam for the weekend to get her ex to leave her alone.

book_title: The Fighter Who Stole My Pulse
special_desc:
Mia's impulsive kiss with mysterious bartender Troy pulls her into the violent underground fighting world where he reigns undefeated. When she saves his opponent's life during a police raid, their dangerous attraction ignites. 
But Troy harbors a devastating secret. His manipulative girlfriend Amanda uses this pain as a weapon, while crime boss Serge plots revenge for his own dark reasons. 
When Mia is kidnapped and used as bait to destroy Troy in the ring, she must save the man she loves from becoming the monster he fears. In this brutal world, love becomes the ultimate fight for redemption. 
He stole her pulse. She might save his soul.

book_title: Park Avenue Girls Don't Play Nice
special_desc: When Anna Sinclair is cheated out of a prestigious art scholarship in Paris, her only chance to escape her abusive parents, she reinvents herself as a glamorous New York socialite to catch the eye of rich kid Preston Kingsley and secure a second shot at her dreams. But things get complicated when she starts to fall for Preston’s best friend, Brooks Whitmore, Upper East Side royalty and the biggest threat to exposing Anna's true identity. Will her secret turn Brooks against her, or will it bring them the happy ending that neither of them saw coming?

Claire’s life as a nurse in a busy hospital is complicated by a supervisor who is intent on making her miserable with tedious and extra tasks. Claire’s only relief is the patients she treats, and even that is not always a picnic. On a rare night off, she attends a dance performance and gets trapped in an elevator with a charming man. There is an instant connection between them, but as they are “rescued” from the elevator, they are pulled away from each other before they can exchange names and numbers. The next day, Claire meets the man again when he is presented as the newest doctor at the hospital. But he doesn’t recognize her in her hospital scrubs and pushes away her attempts to reconnect. Claire is convinced that he isn’t interested. But as she works with him, she can’t ignore her feelings. Meanwhile, the doctor is torn between his developing feelings for Claire and the fond memory of the woman in the elevator. Despite the efforts of some to thwart her, Claire must find the strength to stand up for herself and go after what she wants and deserves: her own chance at happiness.

book_title: My Billionaire Husband Doesn't Remember Me
special_desc: Emma and Cameron were once in love until a fire tore them apart. Years later, Cameron returns seeking revenge, believing Emma betrayed him. After an accident causes him to lose his memory, he thinks Emma is his wife. Can their love survive the secrets, or is it too late for a second chance?
In Alpha's Regret movie, Lila's fated mate, the rival alpha, rejected her. Now, he's back, wanting her and a second chance. But can she trust him...especially when she's hiding their son?

In How To Trap President's Son movie, in a world where money rules everything, he’s the President’s son - a handsome, spoiled playboy above the law. She’s just a cleaning lady with a dream and… a mop. One accidental kiss turns into a media scandal, and suddenly they’re forced to fake a romance for the public.

The new intern, Isla, never imagined that the cold and demanding CEO Christian — who shoved her relentlessly on the tennis court during the day — was the same person who broadened her view to unknown territories at night in an exclusive BDSM club. But when the mask comes off and secretive identities assimilate into reality, is this a game she can stay afloat… or submerge deep within the shadows of desire seeking unexpected redemption?  Produced by：Vantage Entertainment

Caroline has just been diagnosed with cancer in Love Me After My Death movie. And told she only has three months to live when Stacy, her husband Eric's old flame, shows up with a six-year-old kid that she claims is Eric's Child. Eric goes on to repeatedly wrong Caroline, and as her cancer symptoms worsen and she slips into despair, she decides to divorce him. Only after their separation does Eric realize that he can't live without her, and he then finally learns of his ex-wife's cancer diagnosis. By then, it'stoo late for reconciliation, as Caroline is determined not to spend her final days loving him.

Rachel finds herself without a groom on her wedding day, only to realize that her soon-to-be husband is in bed with her own cousin! Refusing to become the laughing stock of town, Rachel decides to continue on with the wedding, there's just one little thing she needs to do… find a new groom!

When Logan Everett rescues Alexis Lee from her abusive boyfriend, a night of passion leads to pregnancy. As their feelings deepen they discover they share a terrible connection: Logan accidentally killed Alexis’s brother during a hockey game the previous year. Can Logan and alexis overcome their violent pasts and build the family they so desperately want?
After being mistreated by his wife’s family for years, Leo discovers that he is the heir to a vast fortune. Now it’s time — for revenge!

book_title: Guarding Her Body, Claiming Her Heart
special_desc: Her life was a fairytale lie until she caught her fiancé in bed with her own brother. When an attempt on her life shatters her last illusions, she is thrown together with the only man she can trust: her new bodyguard, Derek. He’s cold, aloof, and frustratingly professional - yet a single look from his piercing eyes is enough to make her burn. Can she truly trust the man sworn to protect her when everyone else has betrayed her?

Stella is deceived by her fiancé and sister and ends up in someone else's bed. Fortunately, she meets Kevin, the CEO of Galkin Group, but she thinks he’s a gigolo. To save her company, Stella has a flash marriage with him. She’s afraid of encountering troubles, but actually she meets her true love.

book_title: The Doctor Will See You Now
special_desc: In The Doctor Will See You Now movie, when Jane visits the hospital for an allergy, she falls for the handsome doctor, Henry Darcy, at first sight. Gathering her courage, Jane asks for his contact information, only to be coldly rejected multiple times. Undeterred, Jane crafts a plan to win his heart. A sweet romance unfolds between a determined ballerina and a reserved doctor.

book_title: I Gave My wife A Red Tasseled Spear (English-dubbed)
special_desc:
After three years on the battlefield, the wife returns victorious, but unexpectedly pregnant! The former Grand Marshal of the empire's army had retired due to his parents' last wishes and married a woman known for her bravery and ambition. She aspired to achieve greatness on the battlefield, and before she left, he gifted her a legendary spear forged from thousand-year-old cold iron.

Three years later, she returns clad in silver armor, pregnant, and holding another man's hand. She presents a letter of divorce, declaring, "My husband must be a heroic figure who stands tall, not a weak scholar with no strength."

Unbeknownst to her, the seemingly powerless man she had married was actually the empire’s guardian deity. When he dons his marshal armor once again and takes up his legendary weapon, she finally realizes the true identity of the man she once scorned.

In Love Again At 40 movie, Emily, a janitor with minimum wage and a sick daughter to care for, flash marries her ex-boyfriend Mark Cardmon twenty years after he disappeared. And got his face reconfigured due to a car accident. However, neither Emily nor Mark suspected each other of being the person they knew before while falling with each other in love for the second time. Through helping Emily's daughter Selene with her surgery and fending Emily at work from toxic colleagues, Mark gradually realizes that Emily is his boyfriend and Selene is his daughter. Will they finally be able to get married now they are well into their 40s?

book_title: CEO, That Intern is Actually Your Wife (English-dubbed)
special_desc:
My billionaire CEO is my contract-married husband! 
My grandmother fell seriously ill, so I flash-married a stranger for her surgery fees. We entered a one-year contract marriage. I bumped into a handsome man, who I later found out was the CEO of the company I wanted to join! But little did I know, he was the man I married...
As the contract period nears its end, we are supposed to divorce. However, both of us lost our marriage certificates. Now what do we do? Does this mean we can't get divorced after all?

In Pride & Prejudice movie, despite societal pressures to marry, Lizzie Bennet, second eldest of the Bennet sisters, has her heart set on spinsterhood. But when her father falls gravely ill, Lizzie is unexpectedly thrust into the classist world of courtship in order to save her family from destitution. After a fateful encounter with the broody, mysterious millionaire, Mr. Darcy, Lizzie’s forced to choose between denying her feelings for the sake of her family or allowing herself to fall recklessly in love.

book_title: Alpha Revenge: Wolf King and His Human Luna
special_desc: Her parents were cruelly killed by werewolves, yet she has now become the Fated Luna of the werewolf Alpha. However, their love defies werewolf traditions, sparking conflict as they face rogue wolves and ancient prophecies. With hidden powers and fierce rivalries at play, love, destiny, and power clash in this thrilling tale of passion and survival.

book_title: Falling For My Ex's General Dad
special_desc: This story follows a naive yet kind-hearted American girl who travels to Russia in search of her husband, only to discover he is a notorious playboy. Stranded and endangered in a foreign land, she is rescued by a Russian general. Through their growing interactions, her fear of him gradually transforms into admiration and affection. However, in an unexpected twist, the Russian general she falls for turns out to be the father of her deceitful ex-husband. Where will their forbidden love lead them?

In Dungeons of Ecstasy movie, after a near-fatal car crash shatters her body and her heart, travel journalist Emily escapes to remote Italy—only to be ensnared in the mysterious Dungeon of Ecstasy, where her captor, uncannily resembling her long-abandoned ex-husband, forces her through dangerous, sensual trials that awaken forbidden memories and a love she never knew was meant to heal her.

Freya is kidnapped by a coven of witches, hidden away in a tower like Rapunzel, waiting for the day her magic awakens. The evil witche's plan is thwarted when a brave witch hunter saves Freya and runs away with her. Now Freya must navigate a modern world that she's never lived in before, and learn the true meaning of love and sacrifice.

After falling into the water and losing his memory, Warren Davis, a once-powerful chairman, unknowingly becomes a porter at the very hotel he founded. He endures humiliation from his employees - and even his own son, as they treat him as nothing more than a lowly servant, until he remembers who he is.

In Callsign Legacy movie, when lowly enlisted man Cole Summers sneaks into a Navy Flight Simulator and completes mission simulation that no one else can, the Navy realizes that he's their only hope to prevent WWIII...  but first he must deal with crooked politicans, evil tech billionaires, and even his own disgraced family legacy.

book_title: Beg for My Return After Kicking Me Out
special_desc: The U.S. nuclear medical professor Charlie Clare quits his career for family, but is abandoned as his wife and daughter favor his love rival Isaac. After suffering his family’s ignorance, he decides to leave for the Unicorn Project, which he designed for healing his daughter’s neuro-skel birthmark as his life work. But unaware that Charlie’s burning his life for them, his wife and daughter deepen the rift with Charlie upon reunion and eventually destroy everything Charlie left for them with their own hands before realizing their errors, only to find it too late.

book_title: Rock On! Band Beauty in Disguise
special_desc: This story follows Astra, a determined girl gifted with extraordinary strength. When her twin brother loses his voice before a crucial band rehearsal, he’s threatened by a lawsuit. Astra steps in for him. Disguised as a boy, she resides in the boys’ dorm to uphold the ruse despite lacking musical talent and being unmistakably female. Amidst comedic mishaps and tense moments, Astra discovers unexpected love and genuine companionship.

Law student Lily Wingrove has run out of options. Her mother is dying, and the bills keep coming. Desperate, she signs a contract with young mafia boss Eric Moretti, offering her body in exchange for money. Eric moves fast. Money appears. Threats disappear. He is ruthless but magnetic, and every time he saves her, his power pulls her closer. Then he places her in the world of his sworn rival, star prosecutor Daniel Hayes. To the city, Daniel is justice itself. To Lily, he is patient, kind, and everything Eric is not. He protects her with law instead of fear. His love feels pure, even healing. But something beneath his perfection feels wrong. He knows too much, reacts too quickly, and his care sometimes feels like control. Now two men fight for her in opposite ways: one through dominance, the other through devotion. As her mother’s time runs out, Lily must decide who to trust before both the devil’s power and the angel’s secret destroy her.

Corrie Scott, a delivery girl who happened to help an old man. To repay her mother's medical debts, she married his grandson, Charles Francis. Charles is the richest man. At the beginning, he thought this girl was a gold digger, so he hid his true identity. As they lived together, their feelings grew deeper. But his lie gradually became a time bomb, and his childhood sweetheart also came back. Will Charles and Corrie get a happy ending?

In The Fashion Queen Returns movie, once the Queen of the Red Carpet, Eve Corbelle is content with her new life as a housewife--until a sudden betrayal brings her back to the center of her fashion empire at the Grand Maple Gala.

In The Prince's First Love movie, Lucas never expected to kiss a prince—least of all in front of the entire school. What began as a feud with Prince Nicholas turned into a forced friendship, and that into something far more complicated. Every glance, every brush of hands, pulls them closer... but Nicholas is torn between his royal duty and his growing feelings for the boy he once called an enemy. Neither dares to speak the truth—until the moment it can’t be hidden.

In The One I Never Forget movie, five years ago, a tragedy that claimed the lives of loved ones from both sides forced Sofia​ and Justin​ apart, a separation further complicated by Doris's​ lies, Sofia's miscarriage, and Justin's severe injury. Five years later, Sofia returns to Los Angeles as a renowned journalist, while Justin has become a baseball superstar. Their reunion is fraught with conflict, fueled by misunderstandings (Sofia falsely claims to be married; Justin mistakenly believes Sofia left him for money), obstructions (continued opposition from Doris and schemes by Esther), and danger (Esther's plot to commit murder). Ultimately, Justin uncovers the whole truth about the past, Doris confesses her wrongdoing, and Esther is exposed for her crimes and arrested. Transcending their pain, Sofia and Justin achieve dual fulfillment in their careers (Sofia completes her major report; Justin wins a championship) and in love. Their story highlights how honesty and forgiveness can allow love to be reborn from the ruins of lies and violence.

After quelling external disturbances, the best warrior of Republic of Valoria, Zoe Miller, returns to home. However, she discovers that her daughter has been mistreated by her relatives David's family. In a fit of rage, Zoe unleashes a massacre at the banquet, accidentally revealing herself to be the legendary Secretary of Defense. Later, she learned that her adopted son Jacob had already been betrayed by enemy spy Robert, and what was even more astonishing was that Mia's father, President Louis, was also deeply involved in a power vortex. With Mia critically injured and on the verge of death, can Zoe successfully protect her daughter?

book_title: Slay to Fosters: I Took His Uncle
special_desc:
Reborn heiress Emily remembers everything - the false accusations, her family's betrayal, and her death at Olivia's hands. Now armed with knowledge of the past, how will she handle the fake heiress who destroyed her life?
Caroline Harrington, the only daughter of a top wealthy elite family in LA, concealed her true identity and broke away from her family to marry middle-class CEO Liam Foster. Throughout their marriage, she secretly used her family's resources to support Liam's business. However, Natty Parker, the youngest daughter of the Parker family, had long harbored feelings for Liam. She conspired with Liam's mother to set a trap—engineered to make Caroline appear engaged in inappropriate physical contact with Liam's uncle, Connor, right in front of Liam. This misunderstanding led to their divorce, and Caroline was driven out of the household. Heartbroken, Caroline returned to her family, determined to take revenge against her ex-husband and his relatives. Yet, amidst her quest for vengeance, she unexpectedly developed profound feelings for Connor. Meanwhile, after discovering his mother and Natty’s plot to frame Caroline, Liam became determined to win her back. Now torn between Connor—her mature and alluring current husband—and Liam, the man she once deeply loved, Caroline faces an agonizing choice: which path should she take?

Lois bids farewell to the escort who has accompanied her for a month and resolves to marry a man she doesn’t love at all for a marriage of convenience. However, on the day of the engagement banquet, she discovers that the escort is actually the younger brother of her fiancé, Sebastian Hanley.

book_title: Cross My Heart and Hope to Die
special_desc: In search of the truth behind her sister’s death, Zoe Hale marries billionaire Ashton Cross, whom she suspects to be the killer. However, as she gets to know him better, she discovers truth more twisted, and love more powerful than she could’ve ever imagined.

Vera and her husband Lucas once survived a life-or-death fire together. Yet years later, in their contractual marriage, Lucas—plagued by selective amnesia—failed to recognize that his wife was the "white moonlight" he’d never forgotten. Instead, he treated her with cold indifference and even pressed her for a divorce. Vera tried to reveal her true identity to Lucas, only to be sabotaged by her romantic rival. She narrowly escaped death in a car crash, but was rescued just in time by Victor, a powerful mafia boss—who soon realized Vera was his long-lost biological sister. Overnight, Vera—still suffering from memory loss—transformed into a globally dazzling mafia heiress. Meanwhile, Lucas, who’d seemed cold and heartless on the surface, began to act with "tsundere" reluctance: he couldn’t help but go to great lengths to win her back, embarking on an arduous, bittersweet journey to chase his wife. The two navigated countless predicaments—from a wealthy tycoon vying for Vera’s affection, to a two-faced rival scheming against her, and even a seemingly kind man setting traps for them—before finally clearing up their misunderstandings and committing to each other. Just as they found their way back to one another, however, the haunting doubt of "unexpectedly becoming a father" (to a child he didn’t initially recognize as his own) came crashing back…

Flash-Married and Utterly Spoiled movie takes us on an epic journey of Alice who finds out her fiancé Sam is cheating on her with her sister on the day of their engagement.
When she's pushed into the water, her fiancé chooses to save her sister, leaving Alice to die alone. But CEO Leo Klein saves Alice, thus embarking on a loving relationship.
book_sub_title: Happily Ever After: Spoiled by My Billionaire Husband
Flash Marriage CEO Spoils Me a Lot

book_title: The Wife I Despised Is My First Love?! (English-dubbed)
special_desc: Lily, a blind girl, found her boyfriend Brian cheated on her. She accidentally slept with the richest man, Albert Morgan. After becoming pregnant, Brian forced her to demand money from Albert. Under Albert's grandmother's pressure, Albert married Lily. After marriage, Albert despised Lily while searching for his childhood savior, unaware that the true savior was his hated wife. When Lily regained her sight, another woman Gloria appeared. Gloria pretended to be Albert's childhood savior, and bullied Lily...

book_title: I Hate to Love My British Bad Boy
special_desc: In I Hate to Love My British Bad Boy movie, during her first year in high school, Hannah Morrow is losing her virginity to the powerful Jamie St. Clair in their prestigious private school’s library. Jamie breaks up with her in front of the whole school and she loses her scholarship. When the two are reunited their final year, they fake a relationship despite hating each other. But real feelings lay underneath their fake relationship. Will Hannah get back the boy who broke her heart? Or will she lose everything when their fake relationship is exposed?

Syrena and Harrison wake up next to each other one morning to find out they've announced their engagement through Instagram. To protect both of their company's reputations, Syrena and Harrison decide to fake their relationship for the public.

In The Beast on Her Leash movie, to find evidence of Vincent's crimes—the murderer of her parents—Eliza accepts an invitation from Vincent's father to become the president of Evertech AI. Unexpectedly, the father imposes an additional condition: she must educate his youngest son, Ryder, who is as ferocious as a wild beast, into a civilized man. After agreeing, Eliza finds Ryder an extremely difficult man to handle, and the two often clash with intense tension. However, during their coexistence, Ryder falls in love with Eliza. When Eliza realizes she has feelings for Ryder too, she is forced to push him away in order to pursue Vincent's crimes. The entanglement among them is filled with ambiguity and excitement, where opportunities and dangers coexist.

Four years ago, at the wedding arranged by their families, Max, the scion of the conglomerate, was absent, leaving the down-and-out socialite Alice as the nominal Mrs. M. Four years later, Alice has transformed into a well-known divorce case investigator, while Max returns home as the chairman of the M Group and entrusts her with handling his divorce case—neither recognizing the other. The meddling of a scheming colleague and the conspiracy of a cousin pile up one misunderstanding after another. When the truth comes to light, the two, who once passed each other by, finally come together after resolving their knots.

book_title: Marrying A Millionaire with My Baby (English-dubbed)
special_desc: The framed CEO had sex with the woman, but the person who framed him arranged a scumbag man to lie that he had sex with the woman in order to escape the blame. After the woman gave birth to quadruplets, she was told that only one child survived. Many years later, the scumbag man got a promotion and got the woman's house, so he kicked the woman out of the house. At this time, the woman and the CEO reunited...

In I Am Bloody Mary movie, Mare and her fiancé Nick may not have much money, but they have love. As a foster kid with no family of her own, Mare dreams of a wedding with Nick’s family by their side, but Nick is secretive about his estranged relatives. Then, unexpectedly, his mother arrives, warmly inviting Mare into the wealthy and mysterious Thornwood family. She even offers to host the wedding at their grand estate. But the morning of the ceremony, a horrifying discovery shatters Mare's dream, and she realizes she’s not walking into a happy-ever-after, but into a nightmare twisted by the Thornwood family’s dark history--one that might end up killing her.

In Mother Warrior Unleashed movie, when her teenage daughter is grabbed by sex traffickers, the legendary warrior, Navy SEAL Lieutenant Phoenix Ryan, abandons her life of anonymity as a small town diner owner to rescue her daughter and destroy the Navarro Cartel that has taken her.

In Mama, Sing Me a Lullaby movie, Single mother Tracey works hard to raise her twins on her own.  Her youngest son Henry hates his family and considers Logan, his older brother with a heart condition, to be a burden. Logan is hit in a car accident and adopted by a rich man, changing his life forever.
Tracey continued to work odd jobs as a janitor. Both Tracey and Logan never gave up on finding each other, and Logan, now CEO, feels a connection to Tracey the moment they meet again.
Tracey's selfless sacrifice has been wasted on Henry. He finds her embarrassing and is eager to deny knowing her, even actively bullying her.
Finally, at Henry's wedding, just as Henry is about to smash a bottle of wine on Tracey, Logan receives the DNA testing results. The woman on stage being humiliated is his own mother!

book_title: How I Made the Alpha Mine
special_desc: In How I Made the Alpha Mine movie, Luca Conri is the wolf-less runt of the Nightreign Pack, whose bark is bigger than his bite. Tormented by his own Pack and hunted by rivals, Luca is reluctantly put under the protection of his dominant Alpha -- and older brother's best friend -- Dalton Grey. However, everything changes when the two become fated mates, a bond that violates the natural order of the Pack. As enemies close in and traditions try to tear them apart, Luca and Dalton must decide if they want to give into their lustful temptations in a forbidden romance that threatens their own lives.
A cop goes undercover to take down a notorious mob boss but faces a dilemma when she falls for her target, especially since he's the main suspect in her father's murder.

The story follows Leilani, whose adoptive father has been framed by her ex-boyfriend. Desperate for help, she turns to the one man she trusts the least—Diego Marlowe, a ruthless, undefeated attorney who also happens to be her enemy’s future brother-in-law. What begins as a dangerous deal and a fake relationship soon spirals into a high-stakes game of power, secrets, and irresistible attraction. As they use each other to navigate the battles surrounding them, one question lingers: Is Diego truly just her lawyer—or something far more dangerous to her heart?

book_title: My Billionaire Husband Left Me for Him？
special_desc: Joyce wants to divorce her husband Henry because he can't get hard, but Henry won't let her leave their sexless marriage. His inheritance is at stake, as his parents demand an heir before deciding whether to give their business and fortune to him or his brother. Henry is convinced Joyce married him for money, not love. Joyce is determined to prove him wrong, but then her mother is diagnosed with cancer, and they desperately need money...

After three years in a no-love, no-sex arranged marriage, Edith asks for a divorce when she discovers her sexy firefighter husband has gotten another woman pregnant! Even though it means burying her decade-long crush on him! However, her husband refuses to sign unless she agrees to play as a loving couple with him for one last month... Edith is shocked to find that there's a huge misunderstanding between her and her husband...

book_title: I Gave My wife A Red Tasseled Spear
special_desc: After three years on the battlefield, the wife returns victorious, but unexpectedly pregnant! I Gave My wife A Red Tasseled Spear Full Movie tells that the former Grand Marshal of the empire's army had retired due to his parents' last wishes and married a woman known for her bravery and ambition. She aspired to achieve greatness on the battlefield, and before she left, he gifted her a legendary spear forged from thousand-year-old cold iron. Three years later, she returns clad in silver armor, pregnant, and holding another man's hand. She presents a letter of divorce, declaring, "My husband must be a heroic figure who stands tall, not a weak scholar with no strength." Unbeknownst to her, the seemingly powerless man she had married was actually the empire’s guardian deity. When he dons his marshal armor once again and takes up his legendary weapon, she finally realizes the true identity of the man she once scorned.

book_title: Desired by Two: the Vampire and the Hunter
special_desc: I'm a disaster. One minute I'm spilling coffee on my ridiculously hot boss, Simon, the next I'm discovering I have a secret power I can't control. My world is a mess of spilled coffee and tangled feelings, and I'm caught between two unbelievably hot guys. Simon, my mysterious boss, is as alluring as he is dangerous - a vampire who promises to teach me to harness my magic. Then there's Michael, my kind and loyal best friend. But he's hiding a deadly secret: he's a hunter sworn to destroy everything Simon stands for. They both want me. And as my magic gets more powerful, so does the fire burning between us. How can I choose when they both know my darkest secrets?

book_title: Love Trap with My Dashing Knight
special_desc:
In Love Trap with My Dashing Knight movie, the wealthy heiress Emily White marries Tim Carter, a man from humble beginnings, for love. She spares no effort in elevating him to the position of CEO, using her family’s vast resources to secure his success. Yet, after ten years of marriage, Tim betrays her, secretly engaging in an affair with his secretary, Laura Green. Stripped of power, Emily is reduced to a housewife, trapped in a hollow, loveless marriage, suffering alone.
Eager to secure her position, Laura devises a ruthless scheme—she hires a male escort to seduce Emily, planning to obtain "evidence" of her infidelity and force her out of the marriage with nothing. However, in a twist of fate, she mistakenly targets Ryan Clarke, the illegitimate son of the influential Clarke family, believing him to be an escort. The moment Ryan sees Emily, he immediately recognizes her—she is the woman who unknowingly saved him years ago.
Harboring unspoken emotions, Ryan seizes the opportunity and infiltrates the White household, becoming Emily’s chauffeur and live-in assistant. He relentlessly flirts and teases her, awakening long-buried desires within her.

Audrey's biggest regret? A one-night stand with Floyd, her secret love for eight years. Despite his arranged marriage and his family's troubles, he kept rescuing her. She thought she was just a fling, but he was already head over heels for her...

Mia Langford, a talented but financially struggling art student, never expected her quiet life to collide with power, desire, and betrayal. A single reckless moment in class—an impulsive gaze and a forbidden sketch—draws the attention of her professor, Wesley Winslow, a brilliant yet dangerous man whose presence alters the trajectory of her world. Before Mia can understand the shift, her manipulative stepmother arranges a sudden engagement between her and Wesley’s entitled son, Darius—an alliance designed entirely for wealth and influence. But everything changes on a fateful night when, drugged and blindfolded, Mia ends up in Wesley’s arms instead of her fiancé’s. What should have been a mistake becomes an irreversible entanglement—emotionally, physically, and morally. As their forbidden bond deepens, Mia becomes trapped between two powerful men—one who seeks to possess her and one who risks everything to protect her. Darius, driven by jealousy, control, and entitlement, escalates his obsession. He forces Mia into humiliation, threatens her reputation, and captures evidence meant to destroy her future, using blackmail and emotional warfare to keep her under his control. Meanwhile, Mia fights for dignity in a world determined to shame and silence her. Rumors spread on campus, classmates turn against her, and her image becomes a weapon used to dismantle the life she worked so hard to build. Wesley becomes her only refuge—but also her biggest contradiction: the man she should run from, and the only one she wants. Their connection grows from forbidden desire to something dangerously close to love—forcing both to confront their fears, ethics, and the power structures binding them. In a world where everything—her body, her name, her future—is being claimed by others, Mia must decide whether to surrender…or fight for her identity, her freedom, and her own voice.

She sacrificed her career for her husband, only to discover he was cheating and secretly transferring marital assets. To gather evidence for a divorce, she guided her husband's mistress to see his true colors and convinced her to cooperate. Will the alliance between these two rivals be unbreakable or filled with jealousy?

A sudden hospital fire reunites Cindy with her first love, Jackson, after eight long years. Now a heroic fire captain, Jackson risks his life to rescue a nurse trapped in the blaze—only to discover she's none other than Cindy, the woman who shattered his heart during a college break by seemingly cheating on him. As fate begins to turn its wheels, long-buried truths slowly surface. Cindy never betrayed him—instead, she chose to hide her pregnancy to protect Jackson’s future, raising their son Noah alone ever since. Now, facing the child who doesn’t know his true identity, Jackson’s paternal instincts awaken, while Cindy’s long-hidden maternal secret teeters on the edge of revelation. As the flames of their past reignite, they’re met with overwhelming obstacles: a jealous boss, a ruthless mother, sneering colleagues, and a kidnapping plot that pushes Cindy to the brink once more. This is a story of misunderstanding and sacrifice spanning eight years—a journey of love, forgiveness, and impossible choices. When the flames die down, can true love rise from the ashes? He once promised, “Wait for me. I’ll come back to marry you.” She gave everything to keep that hope alive: “For you, I held on to hope.” Love never died—it was only waiting for the fire to return.

book_title: I'm the Dragon King & Legendary Healer
special_desc: A legendary figure has disguised himself as a beggar and is now wandering the streets. The eldest daughter of a prominent financial ruler has been afflicted with a mysterious illness. Despite a substantial reward offered by her father, no expert has been able to cure her. One day, the ruler's second daughter happens to pass by a reward notice and encounters the beggar with a tattered bowl. She drops some change into his bowl, and the beggar, recognizing her kindness, offers to fulfill one of her wishes. He then accompanies her to her family home. The ruler is skeptical that a beggar could cure his critically ill daughter, but the beggar calmly performs his exceptional skills and, indeed...

book_title: Too Late for Love: 15 Days After Miscarriage
special_desc:
In Too Late for Love: 15 Days After Miscarriage movie, Iris and Benjamin were once the ultimate power couple—total relationship goals for everyone, and loaded to boot. They went from college sweethearts straight to tying the knot, and he even gave her a kidney to save her life, swearing he’d love her forever. But by their third year of marriage? Benjamin was hooking up with his mistress out in the open, no shame at all.

Crushed and done with his nonsense, Iris set a "15-day countdown" and quietly planned her divorce and escape. But his pathetic lies and the mistress’s bold-faced disrespect pushed her over the edge—she lost the baby. Completely broken, she finally took off, all by herself.

Benjamin had no clue how much he’d hurt her until she was gone. That’s when his brutal "redemption tour" started—you know, when someone messes up bad and then begs for forgiveness, but it’s already too late. He offered a reward worldwide to find her, but Iris outsmarted him at every turn. His career and reputation? Gone in a flash.

Even after he dumped the mistress, got on his knees to beg for mercy, and took a knife for Iris (ending up seriously hurt), he couldn’t melt her cold heart. In the end, he just had to watch—lonely and full of regret—as she built a new, happy life. And that’s when he finally got it: "Belated love ain’t worth squat"—affection that shows up too late? It’s totally useless.

book_title: In Love with a Single Farmer-Daddy
special_desc: Natalie's conniving grandmother and sister marry her off to a rural farmer, Rhett. He's a single father, looking after a mute daughter, Ellie. Natalie's presence isn't taken kindly, as she is shunned by Ellie and the woman next door. Over time, she learns the woman next door is actually abusing Ellie. She develops a bond with Ellie, which deepens when Ellie speaks up for the first time to save her. But as Natalie starts settling in, new troubles arise. Ellie is bullied at school, and Natalie gets tangled in conflicts involving both her old and new families. She vows to protect the hard-won love and family she's built.

When the British heir dies suddenly, a modern royal family spirals into chaos. Party-loving twins Prince Liam and Princess Eleanor are forced to grow up fast—Liam is thrust toward the crown while falling for Ophelia, the palace security chief’s American daughter, and Eleanor hits rock bottom after a dangerous betrayal. As King Simon grieves and the monarchy teeters, ruthless Queen Helena joins forces with scheming Prince Cyrus to keep control at any cost. A dynasty built on glamour is about to face its darkest reckoning. Buy full season: https://www.lionsgate.com/shows/the-royals/the-royals-season-1

On the eve of her engagement, the female lead escapes her terrifying family and unexpectedly becomes pregnant with the child of a billionaire male lead. The grand hotel where she works is also acquired by him as he pursues her relentlessly. Though she only wants to work hard and prove her own worth, the man’s persistence wears her down. In the end, she not only achieves success at the hotel through her own efforts but is also pampered beyond measure by the man.
book_sub_title: Love in the Hotel: Unconditional Pampering

special_desc:
"Mom, Love Me Again” is about heartwarming eunion.
A mother, diagnosed with Alzheimer’s, forgets her family. Her daughter struggles to reconnect and rebuild their bond. Think “The Notebook” meets “Still Alice”. Get ready for emotional drama, poignant moments, and a powerful celebration of unconditional love!
You can’t ignore the wonder of this amazing tear-jerking.

book_title: The Betrayed Mother is the Divine Heiress
special_desc:
Lena — heir to the divine legacy of Athena.
A nurturing, gentle mother figure, easily moved by compassion, yet beneath her warmth lies a sharp, commanding presence. Once the High Strategos of the fabled Order of Aegis, she vanished from power after a devastating fire twenty-five years ago—when she risked her life to save seven infants and raised them as her own.
For decades, Lena kept her true identity hidden. But on her fiftieth birthday, the seven sons she sacrificed everything for are swayed by their birth families, turning against her and branding her a trafficker. Betrayed and heartbroken, Lena awakens her long-buried power. No longer willing to endure in silence, she rises to reclaim control, expose the truth, and remind the world—and her sons—why she was once feared as a leader destined to command.

The mysterious secret agent Peter Rogers was awarded the National Medal of Honor by the President and had retired from the military. While dining out with his daughter Leslie, Peter is mistaken for a blind date by the beautiful CEO Sydney Greenfield, and the two unexpectedly get married. When his classmate and ex-girlfriend, who were unaware of Peter's true identity, encountered him again, they subjected him to various insults and ridicule. Upon hearing about this, Sydney publicly revealed that Peter was her husband, putting everyone to shame.

In I Leashed A CEO movie, a drunken woman walking her dog late at night was led by the dog to a tycoon’s private car. Chasing the car, her clothes got caught and torn by the door. The two had an intimate SM encounter in the car, fully photographed by paparazzi and making gossip headlines. To calm public anger, the tycoon lied that the woman was his fiancée and searched for her using a dog leash as a clue. His stepsister faked her identity after seeing the news. The woman knew the man that night was the tycoon but dared not tell anyone, nor did she know her sister’s impersonation. She later became his personal bodyguard via an interview, and affection grew between them. Yet the stepsister kept sabotaging their relationship, causing constant conflicts. Will this scandal - triggered farce reveal the truth? Will the two lovers finally get together?

After her mother's recent passing, she was forced into marriage but unexpectedly had a one-night stand with him. Seven years later, a young boy rushes up to him, shouting "Daddy!" He is confused, about to push the child away, when the boy's mother steps forward. He recognizes her as the woman from seven years ago...
book_sub_title: Fall for the Mother of My Children

book_title: Marrying a Billionaire After Ex's Runaway
special_desc: On her wedding day, her fiancé runs away, and her parents don't show up either. Feeling down, she gets hit by a billionaire's car. Surprisingly, the Billionaire turns out to be a hot guy, and guess what? He wants to marry her!
book_sub_title: The Abandoned Bride Married a Tycoon

book_title: The Ghost of You and I
special_desc: In The Ghost of You and I movie, Lieutenant Ryan Cross is fighting on the front lines, but he doesn't tell his wife, Alice, for fear of worrying her. Tragically, Ryan is killed in action while trying to save his comrades. However, his lingering regrets cause him to transform into a ghost and return to his wife’s side. Back home, Alice, who thinks Ryan is just hiding from her, is convinced he's been cheating! Pissed, Alice decides to get back at Ryan by marrying another man. On the day of the wedding, Alice’s bridal car passes Ryan’s funeral procession.

"Retired special forces soldier Cole Slade—codename “Reaper”—goes into hiding as a security guard to fulfill his fallen comrade Alexander’s last wish: protect his younger sister, Victoria. On Victoria’s wedding day, the groom runs away, the guests vanish, and a carefully planned corporate conspiracy comes to light. When the proud Victoria forces Cole into a fake marriage, they’re pushed into an uneasy alliance against their sworn enemy, Tristan—an ambitious man set on taking over the Kingsley family’s tech empire. As Cole’s lethal battlefield instincts resurface—from a bloody fight in the church to displays of overwhelming power at high-society banquets—they face not only Tristan’s deadly retaliation, but also the shocking truth that Victoria’s uncle, Conrad, is the mastermind. When a bloodstained dog tag reveals what really happened to Alexander, Cole must use the most extreme measures to protect this marriage—born from a lie—through both corporate warfare and gunfire."

book_title: The Return of My Drama Queen
special_desc:
The Return of My Drama Queen movie summary takes us to the world of France in a tale of rebirth as we meet Marie Antoinette who wishes to reunite with her while getting executed.
In her new life as Antonia she's not only reunited with her lover but is married to him.
However, their marriage is on the rocks as her husband Nick suggests a divorce.

The Supreme Underworld King movie summary talks about the Underworld Kingpin known as Lord Opulence who saves damsels who are thrown into auction by lustful men. His secret identity is revealed when his wife and daughter are thrown into the auction.
Lord Opulence story is a modern-day magic realism action packed drama with a happy ending as Lord Opulence defeats the enemies.

Jennifer Sullivan, a lawyer, becomes a spy for Isaac Marks in order to save her sister. In the midst of love, hate and conspiracy, she gradually uncovers the truth of the arson case, and when the murderer is finally caught and Isaac reforms, Jennifer decides to let go of her past and make a fresh start with Isaac.

She got drugged and sold by her bestie to a guy. After escaping, she meets a drugged stranger, and they spend the night. Waking up, she finds out her bestie and ex-fiancé betrayed her. Confronting them, she's hurt and caught in a fire. Luckily saved, she later has twins, but one is taken away...
Tessa and Asher were first loves. Asher left without a word due to family reasons. Three years later, they reunite, but Tessa is now the fiancée of Asher's nephew.

book_title: Married a Gardener, Got a Prince
special_desc: Prince Philip of the young Kingdom of Lavinia went to the US to avoid being pressured into marriage. There he met and helped Anna, an American girl who had just been betrayed by her boyfriend. Philip claimed to be a royal gardener and agreed to a flash marriage with Anna. After their marriage, the two worked together to take on Anna's stepmother and stepsister, helping Anna successfully inherit her mother's company and obtain the authorization for royal portraits. In the end, Philip revealed his true identity, got his parents to accept Anna, and the two lived a happy life in California.

book_title: Attractive Model is a Billionaire CEO
special_desc: In Attractive Model is a Billionaire CEO movie: on the night of her divorce, Selina's best friend ordered the top escort, Morgan, at a high-end club. Morgan claimed to be a professional male model, while Selina pretended to be an unemployed office worker. It wasn't until Selina started working at ZT Group that she noticed the new president had the same scratch marks on his neck as that night, and his magnetic voice was all too familiar. At the merger meeting, he threw Selina's proposal in front of her ex-husband and saying: "After all, your wife... no, your ex-wife's taste is indeed much more refined than your lover's."

book_title: The Bride of the Wolf King
special_desc: Hundreds of years ago, a contest of power and desire caused the Wolf King to lose the woman he loved the most. The Wolf King was in tremendous inconsolable grief and he had sealed up his memory. Then somehow the two met again. The grievances and affairs from the previous life slowly emerged. "And this time, I will kill everyone who obstructs our love. And you shall be my princess, the one and only."

In the chaos of a brutal gang shootout, Violet, a nurse, instinctively saves Mattia, the ruthless leader of a powerful crime syndicate, from the brink of death. Little does she know that this act of mercy will ensnare her in a dangerous web of obsession.
Caught in a deadly game of love and betrayal, Violet must confront a heart-wrenching dilemma: stay true to her promise or succumb to Mattia’s seductive yet perilous affection. With each passing moment, the line between love and deception blurs, leading to a suspenseful showdown where only one truth can survive.

book_title: Fated To My Billionaire Call Boy
special_desc: Diane makes a deathbed promise to her grandmother to have a baby—only to immediately uncover proof of her husband Miles' affair. Devastated, she ends their seven-year marriage. In a drunken rebound move (courtesy of her bold bestie Maggie), Diane spends a wild night with a gorgeous callboy named Eddie… but her night blindness hides a jaw-dropping truth:  Eddie is actually Dominic—her and Miles'college classmate who's been secretly in love with her for years. After studying abroad, he's now returned as a ruthless billionaire… and he'll stop at nothing to win Diane back. By day, he's a powerful tycoon; by night, he voluntarily plays her devoted callboy, determined to make her fall for him.

book_title: Midlife Flash Marriage: My Billionaire CEO
special_desc: After her divorce, Amy lost her daughter and raised her son alone. One day, on the way to visit her grandson, she unexpectedly saves Sophie and is introduced to the powerful Mr. Smith. Hiding his true identity, Smith impulsively marries Amy. During their life together, Amy is often bullied by her in-laws, but Smith always steps in to defend her, humiliating the bullies and helping her build a better life. Though Amy’s son is weak and not very capable, he is filial and kind-hearted. Eventually, when his wife’s family goes too far in mistreating Amy, he finally stands by his mother’s side. In the end, Amy discovers that Smith is actually the richest man in the city—and that Sophie is her long-lost daughter. At last, the family is reunited.

After a car accident, Memi falls into a coma—but her soul awakens and witnesses a nurse secretly swapping her newborn son. Powerless to act, Memi watches for seven years as her real son, Nick, suffers abuse. Just as the nurse plans to harvest his corneas to cover the truth, Memi miraculously wakes up and rushes to save him.

book_title: Divorced and Desired! My Trio of Elite Suitors (English-dubbed)
special_desc: In Divorced and Desired! My Trio of Elite Suitors movie, Ivory, a secret billionaire heiress, has invested her time and money in growing her husband. After three years of marriage, her husband, Nelson, changed. He openly embraced another woman. This made Ivory divorce him. Now revealing her identity and being pursued by three wealthy suitors vying for her affection, Ivory navigates her single life.

On their anniversary, Tessa is finally ready to gift her boyfriend her virginity—only to discover he's already sleeping with her cousin. Meanwhile, her work life is no better, with a toxic manager who steals her ideas and makes her daily life a living hell. When she's blindsided with a terminal Leukemia diagnosis, she snaps: quits her job, dumps the cheater, and begins checking off the items on her bucket list.  After a chance encounter at her lowest, captivating CEO Cassian Vaughn can't get her out of his head. Knowing she needs help, he offers her a deal: he'll fund the entirety of her last wishes if she does him the small favor of posing as....his fiancée!
She was framed to death, and he misrecognized their daughter. Given another life, she is going to protect her love ones, and punish the bad!

book_title: Kicked Out Then I Inherited Billions!
special_desc:
Kicked Out Then I Inherited Billions! Movie summary shows how Mu Wan wan gets kicked out by her foster mother after finding her biological sister Mu Lanlan.
Mu Wan wan goes from being homeless to a rich heiress as her lost billionaire father finds her.
Mu Wan wan also finds love with Ye Mohan who offers her a home and a job when being homeless.
Ada, a math genius reclaimed by the noble Selivis family, is treated as an outsider and framed by her scheming sister. But they picked the wrong genius to cross.

In The Adjuster movie, after his sister dies due to losing health coverage, Matteo Leone, a broken man, takes justice into his own hands by killing the insurance company CEO. But he isn't just out for revenge, he has a bigger goal: Expose corrupt health insurance companies for preying on their most vulnerable customers. Matteo stays one step ahead of the police, leaving a trail of clues to send his message, soon becoming a hero to the people the evil CEO's thought they could silence.

book_title: The Working Life of the CEO's Wife
special_desc: I helped an elderly lady I ran into at the supermarket, not realizing her son was the CEO! She gifted me a ring symbolizing the CEO's wife. I hid my identity and continued working in his company as a janitor, but I soon faced constant bullying from other employees. Ultimately, I decided to bravely reveal my true identity and face the challenges ahead…

book_title: Damn! The Duke Got The Wrong Girl
special_desc: After a passionate night together, Ava is shocked to discover that Edmund is the new CEO of her company—and she’s assigned as his secretary. Forced to keep their night a secret, she struggles to navigate their professional and personal boundaries. Meanwhile, her friend Chloe schemes her way into Edmund’s mansion by claiming to be the mysterious woman from that fateful night. As Chloe seduces Edmund and torments Ava, their schemes only bring Edmund and Ava closer. In a stunning twist, Ava learns she is the true heiress to a luxury hotel empire. With the truth revealed, Edmund and Ava finally claim their happily ever after.

book_title: The Billionaire CEO and the Quintuplets
special_desc: Rosalind Scott was set up by her family for a one-night stand with a potential investor but along the line, a mistake happened, and another man slept with Rosalind. She quickly returned home in The Billionaire’s Quintuplets Movie. Matthew Albert was the billionaire who slept with Rosalind instead, and when he returned with gifts, Rosalind was exchanged with her stepsister.

Lucy is excited to be chosen for a reality TV style game show, being streamed online, where contestants complete challenges sent in by the audience, to win big cash prizes. The fun soon turns sinister, as the viewer requests become more perverse.

He was once a genius entrepreneur who dominated the business world. However, due to persecution, he went into hiding, assuming a low-profile life as a designated driver. Twenty years later, to save his son's company from being sabotaged by an old rival, he decides to make a comeback...

Jax Carter, the bastard son of a disgraced housekeeper and a fight gym patriarch, secretly trains under three outlaw coaches. When he's entered into The Crucible, an elite, once-in-a-generation MMA proving ground, he must carry the weight of betrayal, shame, and thousands of pounds of hidden resistance training. As rivals rise and family tries to crush him, Jax must prove once and for all: he wasn’t born to break... he was built to fight.

In Addicted to You movie, Audrey's biggest regret? A one-night stand with Floyd, her secret love for eight years. Despite his arranged marriage and his family's troubles, he kept rescuing her. She thought she was just a fling, but he was already head over heels for her...

book_title: A Relationship Kept in The Dark
special_desc: In A Relationship Kept in The Dark movie, renowned photographer Jane falls for rookie model Hector, unaware he's the heir to a business empire. Hector hides his identity to win her heart, but jealousy and misunderstandings drive them apart. When Jane’s life falls apart, Hector steps in secretly to help—and later reveals his true self with a grand gesture of love and a proposal.

After an unexpected encounter, she gave birth to a son. Six years later, the man from that one-night stand learns the truth and begins searching for the child. In the process, she accidentally crosses paths with him, leading to a series of humorous and contentious interactions. In the end, the son reunites with his paternal family, and they all begin a life filled with happiness and togetherness.

Five-year-old Annie, who can understand animals, saved Landon Hawthorne, a wealthy businessman, from suicide. Now she's his whole world and he's her legal cheat-code against every villain fate throws at them. With her innocence and gift, Annie not only survives dangers but also melts his cold heart—a magical tale of mutual healing.

After enduring a seven-year relationship, the couple ultimately breaks up due to various misunderstandings and betrayals. Subsequently, one partner completely loses the other to an idealized love, leading to a profound realization. Determined to make amends, he attempts to win her back through various means.

In the heart of a bustling city, we meet Emily, a dedicated and hardworking office assistant striving for a better life. When a passionate one-night stand with her charismatic boss, Richard, leads to an unexpected pregnancy, her world takes an unexpected turn...

book_title: Wake Me Up, My First Love
special_desc: In Wake Me Up My First Love movie, Cathy, the fierce boss of the Scorpion Gang, falls into a coma after a staged car accident. When she wakes up, her family elders deceive her into bringing home Prince Alexander of Monaco as a sperm donor to secure an heir. Though they start off disliking each other, sparks slowly begin to fly. Neither of them realizes that Alexander is actually Cathy's long-lost childhood sweetheart—and they’ve been searching for each other all along.

To escape the marriage her mother forced upon her, Nicole Smith boldly sleeps with a stranger and runs away from home with a baby bump. Five years later, she's a devoted single mom to her son, Danny Smith. Just as their life struggles, Marcus Jansen steps into her life, determined to win her heart. Yet, his childhood sweetheart, Zoey Reeves, seethes with jealousy and keeps causing trouble. Little do they know, Marcus is the father of Nicole's son, and her true identity holds even more surprises...

book_title: CEO, That Intern is Actually Your Wife
special_desc:
My billionaire CEO is my contract-married husband! 
My grandmother fell seriously ill, so I flash-married a stranger for her surgery fees. We entered a one-year contract marriage. I bumped into a handsome man, who I later found out was the CEO of the company I wanted to join! But little did I know, he was the man I married...
As the contract period nears its end, we are supposed to divorce. However, both of us lost our marriage certificates. Now what do we do? Does this mean we can't get divorced after all?

He possesses superb medical skills, but after marriage, he took the initiative to be a house husband. However, in his wife's heart, he was worthless and unreliable. She insisted on divorce. However, later when she knew the truth, she begged him to save her grandfather and was willing to remarry him...
They mistook each other for the partner in the contractual marriage. After the flash marriage, they discovered that they were meant for each other.

book_title: My Homeless Hubby Is a Trillionaire
special_desc: On the eve of her wedding, she discovers her fiancé's infidelity. In a fit of anger, she marries a stranger on a whim. Little did she know that her handsome homeless husband is actually a trillionaire CEO!
book_sub_title: Beneath the Rags: My Hubby Is a Billionaire
From Rags to Riches: CEO Romance

book_title: The Double Life of Mr President
special_desc: Claire, a small-town girl working at a fried chicken shop, accidentally stumbles into the hotel suite of U.S. President William. After helping him relieve an aphrodisiac’s effects with her body, she then aids the gunshot-wounded president in evading his pursuers. Grateful, William proposes a contractual marriage—but Claire mistakenly believes he’s just a presidential body double. The truth only comes crashing down when she’s kidnapped by the mafia and William storms in with a Special Forces team.

book_title: Pregnant By The Luxury Empire Heir
special_desc: Sofia, a sales associate at a luxury boutique, and Bryan, the domineering CEO of a luxury conglomerate, unexpectedly have a one-night stand that results in her pregnancy. At work, Sofia faces bullying and sabotage from jealous colleagues, while at home, she is exploited by her mother and younger siblings for money. Throughout her struggles, Bryan steps in to confront her toxic coworkers and family, gradually becoming captivated by her resilience. Eventually, he proposes to her formally, and the two embark on a happy life together.

After a one - night stand with a handsome stranger, Sarah, a young campaign intern, realized that he was her boss, Senatorial candidate Christopher. In a tough campaign, their affair would be a career - ending scandal for both of them, so she concealed her identity. But did Christopher fall in love with her or the role she was playing? Will their love story destroy them or can they survive the scandal and become a powerful couple in the political world?

Selina Murphy, a wealthy heiress, goes undercover as an intern at her fiancé's company—only to cross paths with Grace, a cunning opportunist from the wrong side of the tracks. Grace brazenly steals Selina's identity and, with the help of their coworkers, relentlessly bullies the "new girl." But Grace picked the wrong target this time. The real heiress is about to fight back.
Anna Nix is sent to a juvenile prison for the murder of her abusive stepfather. In the prison, she discovers relationships, drugs, complex mental illness, and her eventual search for redemption.

book_title: Secret Life of A Mafia Sweetheart
