special_desc: Two heirs of rival mafia families fall in love under false identities. A gang war leaves Alyssa injured with amnesia, Dylan poses as her fiancé，entangling them in love, betrayal, and buried family secrets…

"I shouldn't have ever saved you and brought you up this mountain!" I am an orphan, study divine skilled with my teacher, and now come down the mountain to gain experiences. On the first day, I meet a girl, and saved her fatehr's life. book_title: The Spoiled Miss is a Hidden Big Shot
special_desc: On the day of her grandmother's funeral, she gets kicked out of her home. In reality, she’s the long-lost sixth daughter of a prominent family. When she returns, her adoptive sister makes her life difficult, and she’s pressured to fulfill an engagement with another family. Little does she know, her fiancé is the very person she has already fallen for.

book_title: The Power of Love: A Disabled Tycoon's Heart
special_desc: The female protagonist marries her boyfriend to inherit the family business, only to discover on her wedding day that she has stomach cancer and is immediately abandoned by her boyfriend! To get back at the scoundrel, she quickly marries a blind man, only to find out after the marriage that he is not blind at all, but the wealthiest person in the city. The female lead and her husband join forces to confront the scoundrel and the unfaithful woman, regain their family fortune, and after learning of the misdiagnosis, they live happily ever after.

Trapped in a decade-long nightmare of family control, she meets a man who seems like the perfect way out. At first, she uses him to escape, but his unconditional trust and devotion slowly melt her guarded heart. What begins as a calculated plan turns into an unexpected journey of love, healing, and finding the strength to start anew.

The Taming Of A Good Girl

book_title: Love After Rebirth: Spoiled by My Husband's Uncle (English-dubbed)
special_desc: In her past life, she was betrayed and killed by her husband. Now reborn, she finds herself back on the day they met each other's families. This time, she makes a bold choice—she leaves her husband-to-be and chooses his powerful, enigmatic uncle instead. Despite rumors about his supposed shortcomings, their union quickly blossoms into a life filled with unexpected surprises, including triplets!

book_title: Irresistible love with my brother in law
special_desc: Amelia, a young widow, was pregnant with the posthumous child of her late husband Daniel. She was taken back to the Tuscan estate of the ancient and powerful Di Maggio family in Italy for protection. At first, Anthony, Daniel's older brother, was hostile towards Amelia, seeing her as a threat. But through repeated conflicts and time spent together, he was deeply attracted to her resilience and sincerity. Under the pressure of family disputes and traditional responsibilities, Amelia and Anthony overcame suspicion and prejudice and gradually developed a sincere and passionate relationship. In the Tuscan sunshine and the shadow of the ancient estate, they jointly protected the unborn child and the future of the family while experiencing a new chapter of love for each other.

As a kid, the heiress was taken away but found her family later. Her foster sister got jealous and tricked her, causing her mom's death. But, she also got pregnant by a rich guy. Pretending to be dead, she came back after five years, determined to make those who hurt her pay for it.
book_sub_title: Forged in Fire: Her Vengeful Rebirth

special_desc:
In “The Wife’s Revenge”, betrayal Ignites Fury!
We’ve got a scorned wife seeking bloody vengeance against her cheating husband and his mistress. Secrets, lies, and explosive confrontations ensue! Think “Gone Girl” meets “The Sopranos”. You should get ready for gripping suspense, shocking twists, and an empowering journey of self-discovery!
Time for some of that the fiery revenge!

Billionaire’s Second Chance Wife movie summary is all about Lillian Hart, a single divorced mother who meets CEO Frederick Harrington after a blind date mishap.
Frederick offers to marry Lillian Hart when she's bullied by her ex-husband Nathan along with his mistress. Lillian doesn't know her flash marriage husband is a CEO billionaire and that she was on a wrong date.

Talia Stone comes from a wealthy family. Her dad is a billionaire and her three brothers are bigwigs in the military, showbiz and finance world. She saved her childhood friend Jack Chase in an accident and almost lost her legs. Talia's legs were saved by top doctors in the field, but she remained in a wheelchair at her dad's request, as a test for Jack's feelings. The day before their wedding, Talia found out Jack was cheating with her friend Rachel. Enraged by the pair's brazen denial, Talia pretended to turn the other cheek while setting up a plan to humiliate them at the wedding. She then met Aiden Brooks who got her purse back from a thief and asked him half-jokingly to marry her. To her surprise, Aiden said yes. The next day, Talia's supposed wedding turned into a big stage for drama.
